profile.headline: Java Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in Java, JavaScript and PL/SQL utilizing both traditional and agile methodologies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I currently work full-time-remote out of Dayton.

-The following tools were employed in the creation, modification and maintenance of software solutions for the Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS): Java, XML, HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, Struts 2, SQL, PL/SQL, Eclipse, MS SQL Developer, Oracle 11g, Tomcat and the MVC (Model View Controller) development architecture
-Analyzed functional design documentation, conducted peer reviews, Unit Tested all code and implemented system changes and enhancements
-Created technical specifications and analysis documentation; participated in systems requirement reviews and coordinated with customer/functional representatives and other technical personnel to clarify requirements
-Analyzed functional and technical requirements of proposed or existing IT systems to determine avenues of development or modification necessary to meet mission objectives
-Identified how system modifications, new systems or subsystems impact current systems; established target completion dates; prioritized proposed system changes and new development efforts
-Prepared system documentation for purposes of improving software development processes in accordance with acceptable industry standards

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Oversaw the development of a new document creation module which would enable users to create printable documents such as invoices and reports  
-Java development utilizing multiple graphics libraries to produce new interfaces 
-Interfaces designed to provide the user with a cleaner and less intimidating experience
-Used the GIT version control system

positions.title: Content Developer
positions.description:
-Excellent communication skills used with artists, testers and game designers to bring about the desired product result
-Utilized a JavaScript type language to produce high end professional user interfaces
-Participated in large scale discussions to demonstrate the content produced and explain the development decisions made
-Employed the Agile development methodology to quickly generate high quality content

positions.title: PeopleSoft Developer
positions.description:
-Responsible for interpreting functional designs to aid the creation of technical designs
-Created technical designs which would be the basis for later development
-Used technical designs to aid development in multiple platforms
-Developed applications using PeopleCode, SQL and SQR script
-Wrote unit test scripts for use in testing individual programs
-Tools used included PeopleTools, Text editors, Stat, SQR and Application Engines
-Modified PeopleSoft delivered software to meet customer requirements
-Custom applications were created for which no PeopleSoft delivered functionality existed
-Multiple tools were used to track progress including Task Tracker and Jira
